notes: Both verbless predicates (עֹלָה הוּא, אִשֶּׁה הוּא) take the construction's copula, the subject pronouns keeping only it (rule 20).
אִשֶּׁה heads on fire; heading on offering is the competing reading and is noted on the unit.
כָּל־הָאַיִל writes its article on the rectum, which takes the phrase's single the (rule 29).
